description:
Hushfeed v0.48.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Feed filter now starts with Calm feed. It turns on six focused filters together, saves the prior values and restores that exact setup later. Stories, photo posts, AI labels, creator rules, keywords and time limits stay untouched. The status card shows whether the preset is on or has been adjusted.

Validation: 1449 runtime tests passed locally, plus 243 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. Every patch applied with zero failures to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with no unexpected manifest changes. The exact release bundle was installed on the dedicated S22 with the same signing key. TikTok launched, Hushfeed stayed first in Settings and privacy, Calm feed applied, and the prior feed setup was restored. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
